summary: Rows 51-61 are the 11 Brain's Base OADs (AniList 11813, bundled with manga volumes 46-56, 2012-2014), adopted as episodes 51-61. They adapt the Yami/YOMI saga (Battles 144-195) OUT OF MANGA ORDER with gaps: airing order is Eclair-opening (144-145) -> Spark (158-166) -> Eclair (145-150) -> YOMI-intro Sho (167-172) -> Apachai-flashback backfill (106-109, content the 2006 TV run skipped between our eps 39-40) -> Boris (175-180a) -> Takeda/Shiba (173-174) -> Bankruptcy arena (193-195) -> Snow Summit (181-188 + first half of 196 as epilogue). Never adapted: 151-157 (Shigure's Childhood arc + Spark opening), 168-169 (unmarked on wiki chapter pages), 180 second half, 189-192, 196 second half. OAD 1 is largely an author-original scenario per ja.wikipedia (uses elements of 144-145) -> typed mixed. Chapter-exact mapping comes from kenichi.fandom's three mutually-agreeing page families (OVA pages, arc pages with battle ranges, Battle chapter infoboxes with 'Corresponding episode' fields); English Wikipedia independently corroborates every OVA's content at arc level; wiki volume fields match our volume boundaries (same chapter space).

type_corrections.note: ja.wikipedia: OAD 1 is an author-original written scenario (原作者オリジナルの書き下ろし); fandom Battle 144 infobox says 'OVA 1 (partially)' and the OVA page says elements of 144-145 are used — canon chapter material inside an original frame

structure.notes: Rows 51-61 = the 11 Brain's Base OADs ('OVA' component, AniList 11813), each bundled with a manga volume (46, 47, 49, 53, 53, 54, 54, 55, 55, 56, 56) 2012-2014, later broadcast on TV Apr-Jun 2014. They resume after the TV finale (ch 143) and adapt the Yami/YOMI saga to ch 195 plus half of 196, non-linearly. Never adapted anywhere: 151-157 (Shigure's Childhood arc + Spark opening), 168-169 (unmarked; possibly compressed into ep 54), 180 second half, 189-192, 196 second half. OAD 5 is a backfill of TV-skipped 106-109. Wiki chapter numbering ('Battle N') and volume fields match our chapter space and volume boundaries exactly (e.g. Battle 180 -> v21, Battle 189 -> v22). Max adapted mainline chapter after the OADs: 195 (plus 196 first half).

flags_for_sean: Continue-point policy: Shigure's Childhood arc 151-157 is a permanent mid-run adaptation gap (no OAD covers it) — ep 53's continue->151 encodes it, but the series-final continue (ep 61 -> 189) skips past it; decide which gap the reader-facing resume should surface.

Battles 168-169 have no 'Corresponding episode' on the wiki and sit inside ep 54's arc slice (167, 170-172) — unresolved whether they were compressed into OAD 4 or genuinely skipped; anchored ep 54 as 167-172 span with the gap noted.
Battle 147 similarly unmarked inside ep 53's 145-150 slice — presumed covered (arc page assigns the whole Eclair arc to OVAs 1+3).
